json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

content.content:
We need to produce a travel plan for 7 days (March 8-14 2022) starting from Miami, visiting 3 different cities in California. Provide daily itineraries with transportation, meals, attractions, accommodation. Must call submit_day_plan for each day. No follow-up. We need to consider budget $7200 for 2 people. Provide reasonable flights, accommodations, meals, attractions. Probably cities: Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco. Or maybe Los Angeles, San Diego, Santa Barbara. But three different cities in California. Let's pick Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco.

Day 1 (Mar 8): Flight from Miami to Los Angeles. Accommodation in LA. Meals: breakfast maybe on plane or at airport? Use restaurant names. Provide attractions: Griffith Observatory, Santa Monica Pier. Provide transportation: Flight details.

Day 2 (Mar 9): LA full day. Breakfast at The Griddle Café. Attractions: Getty Center, Hollywood Walk of Fame. Lunch: Mexican cuisine - Guelaguetza. Dinner: American - In-N-Out Burger.

Day 3 (Mar 10): Travel from LA to San Diego by rental car or flight. Provide transportation: Drive with rental car. Breakfast at hotel. Attraction: San Diego Zoo. Lunch: Mexican - Lucha Libre Taco Shop. Dinner: American - Harbor House.

Day 4 (Mar 11): San Diego full day. Breakfast at Café 222. Attractions: Balboa Park, USS Midway Museum. Lunch: Mexican - Oscar's Mexican Seafood. Dinner: American - The Fish Market.

Day 5 (Mar 12): Travel from San Diego to San Francisco (flight). Transportation: Flight. Breakfast on flight? Provide. Attraction: Golden Gate Bridge. Lunch: Mexican - La Taqueria. Dinner: American - House of Prime Rib.

Day 6 (Mar 13): San Francisco full day. Breakfast at Mama's on Washington Square. Attractions: Alcatraz Island, Fisherman's Wharf. Lunch: Mexican - Taqueria Cancun. Dinner: American - Zuni Café.

Day 7 (Mar 14): Return from San Francisco to Miami. Flight. Breakfast at hotel. Lunch maybe at airport. End.
